name: Mountain View Baptist Church
addr: 2221 N Fork-Right Fork Rd, Black Mountain

reviews.t: We found Mountain View Church about 5 years ago, or should I say Mountain View Church found us. We fell in love with the Church, friendly staff and congregation, and the pastor, after the first visit. If you want a Church that can move mountains and that cares for its people, Mountain View Church is for you.

They have a great celebrate recovery program. People are friendly and welcoming. We serve a meal every week at CR ,with dessert. If you need help with your hurts ,habits, and hang-ups, please visit. You will be more than welcomed by others who attend and run the program. They also have great worship, hour and lessons, or testimonies. Come join us.
It's a really nice church, but not alot of prayer and the people and the pastor were not very friendly. The pastor never even came over to us.

Came with our churches youth group on a retreat. This church was phenomenal. They made sure we were welcome, had coffee, and talked to us. The service was great! Songs were an even mix of old and new, which was amazing.
Wonderful people, awesome youth group, and great pastors and staff! We couldn’t be more thankful God sent us to this church!

I've been attending Mountain View Church for many years now. Paster Brent is a great Pastor and they have a Wonderful Youth program, thanks to Josh our Youth Pastor! If you are thinking of attending church and not sure where to go, Mountain View should be your #1 choice! Everyone is welcoming and ALL are welcome!
Beautiful location, friendly people, excellent child care, caring pastor
I've been a member since I was a child (13). Blessed to worship here. Truth is taught. Jesus is magnified. People are loved. Safe. Clean. Approachable.
Celebrate recovery baby 🍼😘❤️ It is good to fellowship, break bread, dig deep, and get to know the Lord. Amen! …
Blessed place We went as guest to this place,it was great blessing We enjoyed the fellowship Worship was good Pastor shared powerful words from Psalms 91
